# Result tables of the improvement study (generated by `experiments/improve_study/tables.py`)

All figures are development evidence from offline recorded-trace replay (no live agent, no reviewer). Intervals: paired grouped bootstrap, 2,000 resamples, seed 20261027; task completion clustered by user task (16 groups), attack success by injection task (9 groups).
